animations.notes: 37 entrance animations via Animate.css. Widgets use _animation/_animation_delay in data-settings JSON. Sections use animation/animation_delay. Elements start with elementor-invisible class, IntersectionObserver adds animated + animation name class. Pro adds motion effects (scroll parallax, mouse tracking).

quirks.description: Sites can use legacy section/column layout (.elementor-section), modern flexbox containers (.e-con), or BOTH simultaneously. Section hierarchy has 6 nesting levels; container has 3-4.
quirks.workaround: Use combined selector '.elementor-top-section, .e-con.e-parent' for section discovery. Handle both DOM structures.

quirks.description: Theme Builder creates only 3 body children (header, page wrapper, footer), triggering false SPA detection.
quirks.workaround: spaContainerHints unwrap [data-elementor-type='wp-page'] to find actual sections.

quirks.description: data-settings attribute contains animation data, motion effects, layout settings, and widget config in one JSON object. Animation keys differ: widgets use _animation (underscore prefix), sections use animation (no prefix).
quirks.workaround: Parse data-settings JSON per element. Check both _animation and animation keys.

quirks.description: Plugin-based (data-lazy-src with SVG placeholder), WordPress native (loading='lazy'), and Elementor's Optimized Image Loading can all coexist on the same page.
quirks.workaround: Check data-lazy-src, data-src, and src attributes. Scroll to trigger IntersectionObserver-based lazy loaders.

quirks.description: Elementor generates per-page CSS at /wp-content/uploads/elementor/css/post-{id}.css plus global CSS and per-widget CSS. Styles split across 10-15+ files.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles rather than trying to parse individual CSS files.

quirks.description: Shape dividers (.elementor-shape) contain inline SVG paths inside sections. Purely decorative but inflate DOM element count.
quirks.workaround: Skip .elementor-shape in section discovery. Capture SVG content during style extraction for visual fidelity.

quirks.description: Elements with entrance animations start with elementor-invisible class (visibility: hidden). Screenshots before animation trigger will show blank areas.
quirks.workaround: Before extracting, remove elementor-invisible class from all elements and add animated class to trigger final state.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
